source:
aux fn isPrime(int m ? m >= 2)
    = prod d from 2 to m-1 (
        define remainder m % d
        = 0 ? (remainder == 0) else 1
    )
end
name: isPrime

spotlights.note: Try the possible divisors. An empty product is 1.
A remainder of zero means d divides m.
One divisor makes the product zero. Otherwise it stays 1.
